tasks.instruction_text: Quick one on Apartments.com Houston TX condo rentals: I want to mirror what I asked the assistant earlier — "Find a condo for rent in Houston, TX, with a monthly rent of no more than 30% of an income of $8000. The condo should have a minimum area of 600 square feet, and the move-in date is the 1st of next month". The only piece that isn't on the visible filter row is 'Max rent ≤ 30% income', which is hidden behind the dark-green 'Filters' button at the right of the filter row (it opens a hidden panel of extra checkboxes). Just turn that one on and apply it.

Looking at Houston condo rentals on Apartments.com Houston TX condo rentals — apply concierge service and garage parking both. They live behind the dark-green 'Filters' button at the right of the filter row (it opens a hidden panel of extra checkboxes); once you open it you'll see them as checkboxes. Don't forget to confirm.

And honestly floor-to-ceiling windows is becoming a deal-breaker too — turn it on. Both toggles live under the dark-green 'Filters' button at the right of the filter row (it opens a hidden panel of extra checkboxes) so you'll have to open that to find them; they're not in the visible filter dropdowns.

For my shortlist on Apartments.com Houston TX condo rentals, narrow Houston condo rentals down to ones that satisfy all three of: cats & dogs OK, rooftop pool, and floor-to-ceiling windows. Heads up — none of these are on the visible filter bar; you have to crack open the dark-green 'Filters' button at the right of the filter row (it opens a hidden panel of extra checkboxes) and tick each one before hitting apply.

Hop into Apartments.com Houston TX condo rentals, pop open the dark-green 'Filters' button at the right of the filter row (it opens a hidden panel of extra checkboxes), and tick 'Floor-to-ceiling windows' — that toggle is NOT on the main filter row, it's hidden inside. Neither shows up in the standard dropdowns; they're only inside that hidden panel. After both are applied, tell me how many listings match in total.

Inside the dark-green 'Filters' button at the right of the filter row (it opens a hidden panel of extra checkboxes) (the hidden filter panel — NOT the main bar), flip on floor-to-ceiling windows, concierge service, and move-in 1st of next month. All of those are hidden in there. Once they're all applied, look at what's left and tell me the address + sqft of the single LARGEST rentals still showing.
